name: Premier Technical Plastics
old_description: Performance is what sets Premier Technical Plastics apart from other custom plastics injection molders. By combining the expertise of our technical services group with state-of-the-art equipment and professional project management, we ensure that the expectations and requirements of our customers are met on time, every time.
about:
Premier Technical Plastics was founded in 1981 in Searcy, Arkansas. The company has operated as a custom plastics injection molder for over four decades, building a reputation for performance and quality in the plastics manufacturing industry.

The company specializes in custom injection molding of plastics components and assemblies, with a core capability in two-shot injection molding—a process that injects two different materials sequentially in a single mold cycle. Premier Technical Plastics also operates a technical services group and uses state-of-the-art equipment with professional project management. In 2026, the company plans to expand its facility infrastructure, add two-shot molding capacity, and install two pad printing lines and corona surface treatment equipment for specialized decorative processes.

Premier Technical Plastics serves customers requiring custom injection-molded plastics components and assemblies, though specific industries are not detailed in available materials.

The company emphasizes performance, combining technical expertise, advanced equipment, and project management to meet customer expectations on time. Its quality policy stresses continuous improvement, competitive pricing, and prompt service, backed by ISO 9001:2015 registration and UL certification for fabricated parts.
